facts: The public form identifies the role as Team Coordinator, Remote in Saudi Arabia, in AI/ML Data Collection – AI Device Testing.
The form requires a Resume/CV, full name, email, a brief comment on experience and qualifications, consent to data processing, and an academy communication preference.
Industrial Engineering student at the University of Business and Technology in Jeddah; degree in progress since March 2022.

Logistics & Operations Coordinator at UBT from June 2022 to December 2025, coordinating travel, accommodation, logistics frameworks, volunteer workforces, and liaison operations for international athletic contingents.
Purchasing Assistant at Aljabr from March 2024 to August 2024, supporting procurement operations, vendor relationships, purchase orders, and market research.
Languages listed in the candidate profile: English, Arabic, Somali, and Filipino.

draft: I am applying for the Team Coordinator role in Saudi Arabia. I am currently completing a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering at the University of Business and Technology in Jeddah. In my Logistics & Operations Coordinator role at UBT, I coordinated travel, accommodation, and logistics frameworks for international athletic contingents, supported liaison operations, and helped direct volunteer workforces for large events. I also supported procurement, vendor communication, purchase orders, and market research as a Purchasing Assistant at Aljabr. These experiences developed the organization, communication, follow-through, and cross-functional coordination skills I would bring to TSMG's AI/ML data-collection work.
